jobs.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role We're seeking an experienced software engineer to build the platform behind governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) at Anthropic. Compliance information lives across dozens of systems, from cloud infrastructure and identity providers to HR platforms and code repositories. You'll build the pipelines, integrations, and services that bring that data together and turn it into automated checks, real-time dashboards, and evidence for real time decision making, compliance obligations, and to support expanding the markets we can serve. You will be an early member of the team, collaborating with stakeholders across Security, IT, Engineering, Privacy Engineering, Legal, Finance, and more to turn manual compliance processes into scalable, reliable systems. You will lead your own projects end to end, and you will put Claude to work as an extension of the team through agentic workflows for evidence collection, analysis, and continuous monitoring. If you've built internal platforms, data pipelines, or privacy systems, you'll feel right at home, and you don't need a compliance background to get started. Key responsibilities Design and build data pipelines that aggregate risk, control, and asset information from across Anthropic's technology stack, solving hard integration problems like disparate schemas, inconsistent data quality, and unified views of posture Build and maintain integrations connecting our platform to cloud infrastructure, identity management, HRIS, ticketing, version control, and CI/CD systems to enable automated evidence collection and continuous validation Translate written policies and regulatory requirements into policy-as-code, turning static documents and spreadsheets into enforceable rules, automated checks, and continuous monitoring Design and deploy agentic workflows where Claude handles work that previously required manual effort, such as analyzing evidence, generating audit responses, and monitoring control effectiveness Develop dashboards and reporting that provide real-time visibility into risk and compliance posture for audiences ranging from engineers to executives and external auditors Make architectural decisions that shape how the platform grows, establishing patterns and tooling that other engineers will build on Partner with Security, IT, Infrastructure, and product engineering teams to make controls and evidence collection native to how Anthropic builds and ships Operate what you build, owning reliability and data integrity for systems that audits and executive reporting depend on Minimum qualifications Have 8+ years of experience building backend systems, data pipelines, or internal platforms that other teams depend on, ideally operating at tech lead level Are a systems thinker who understands how data flows between systems, where the integration points are, and what breaks when systems don't talk to each other Have depth in either integration engineering (REST APIs, webhooks, authentication flows, event-driven architectures) or data infrastructure (warehousing, ELT/ETL, orchestration), and fluency in the other Are proficient in Python, Go, or similar languages, and have production experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and infrastructure-as-code Hold a high bar for data quality and reliability, and enjoy turning ambiguous, manual processes into simple, reliable automated systems Take full ownership of your work, from design through deployment and operations, and can navigate ambiguity and make sound technical decisions independently Take a product-focused approach to platform work and care about building tools internal customers love to use Are excited to build with LLMs as system components, designing agentic workflows, evaluating their outputs, and making them reliable enough for high-stakes use Preferred qualifications Experience in domains where engineering meets regulation, such as privacy engineering, data governance, fintech, healthcare, or trust and safety Experience designing and shipping LLM-based or agentic automation in production or operational contexts Familiarity with compliance frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, FedRAMP) or GRC platforms (ServiceNow, Vanta, Drata, OneTrust); this is helpful but not required Prior experience at And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. Robinhood is seeking a Software Engineer to join the Enterprise Build team: the small, high-leverage team that turns the company's best AI-built prototypes into true enterprise-grade services. Robinhood has gone all-in on an AI-accelerated workforce: every week, Hoodies across Finance, HR, Legal, Compliance, and beyond use sanctioned AI tools to build working prototypes of the tools they wish they had. The best of those ideas deserve to become real software. That is this team's entire job, and yours. The team is built on the premise that AI multiplies what a senior engineer can own: agents do the first pass of assessment, porting, and scaffolding; you review, harden, and decide. The work is a distinctive loop. A prototype earns real usage in our experimental sandbox and arrives through a single front door. You assess it, decide what survives, often the idea and the workflow, rarely the code, and rebuild it as an enterprise-grade, production-spec service that meets our full engineering standards: SSO, audit logging, secrets management, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, and security review, baked in from the first commit. While you build, you work directly with business partners, the forward-deployed pattern, pointed inward. Robinhood operates in a heavily regulated industry. Building fast here means building safely, and this team exists to help make sure those aren't in tension. This role is based in our Menlo Park, CA office, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week. At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. What You'll Do Assess vibe-coded prototypes from across the company and make the technical call: harden, rebuild, or redirect, then own the outcome end-to-end. Design, build, and ship services on Robinhood's enterprise platforms, meeting the company's full standards for secure, reliable enterprise software. Build AI-natively: drive agents through first-pass assessment, porting, and test scaffolding, and ship MCP servers, sub-agents, and agent skills as production artifacts where the solution calls for them. Work directly with sponsoring business units (Finance, HR, Legal, Compliance) during each build, translating real workflows into software people actually adopt. Deliver clean operational handoffs as part of your definition of done: runbooks, evals, and dashboards. Establish the paved patterns with the Enterprise Platforms team: when you solve the same problem twice, make it a platform capability the third time. Raise the bar on AI-era engineering quality, including rigorous, teaching-quality review of AI-generated code, your own and others'. jobs.description: WE ARE AN APPLIED AI LAB BUILDING END-TO-END SOFTWARE AGENTS. We're the makers of Devin, the first AI software engineer. Our team is extremely talent-dense. Among our founding team, we have world-class competitive programmers, former founders, and leaders from companies at the cutting edge of AI including Scale AI, Palantir, Cursor, Waymo, Tesla, Lunchclub, Modal, Google DeepMind, and Nuro. Building Devin is just the first step—our hardest challenges still lie ahead. If you’re excited to solve some of the world’s biggest problems and build AI that can reason on real-world tasks, apply to join us. ABOUT THE ROLE As Merch Manager at Cognition, you will own every piece of merch that represents our brand outside the company. That covers event swag, customer and prospect gifts, custom orders for our GTM teams, our merch store, and of course, our infamous Devin plushies. Your work will turn our brand into something tangible and help our sales and marketing teams build relationships. You will own the merch program end to end, from request and approval through production, fulfillment and delivery. Every item should reflect our brand at the highest level of quality and arrive where it needs to be, on time. This role is execution-heavy. We are looking for someone who loves logistics, stays calm under a high volume of requests, communicates clearly with every stakeholder, and works closely with vendors. We have plenty of creative voices. We need someone who can turn ideas into products that ship. IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL: - Own all external merch, including event swag, customer and prospect gifting, custom team orders, our merch store and plushies - Take in and prioritize a high volume of custom requests from Sales, Marketing and Events (often 10+ a day), manage approvals, and make sure every order is fulfilled and delivered - Serve as the primary point of contact for merch vendors and production partners, running regular order reviews, negotiating pricing and timelines, and holding partners to a high quality bar - Partner closely with Brand Design to ensure all merch and collateral adheres to Cognition's brand guidelines, securing design approval on every piece before it goes out - Build a single, scalable intake process that replaces scattered requests across Slack - Forecast demand and inventory across events, campaigns and regions - Partner with Revenue Marketing to set budget guardrails that decide when teams can order directly and when they need approval, based on event size and expected ROI - Create repeatable processes, playbooks and documentation that scale alongside Cognition's growth REQUIREMENTS FOR THE ROLE: - 4+ years of experience running merch, promotional products, swag or gifting programs, at a high-growth company or at an agency or production partner with high standards - Proven ability to manage many concurrent orders and stakeholders end to end without dropping details - Experience managing suppliers, production timelines and domestic and international fulfillment - Strong organizational rigor, attention to detail, and a high personal quality bar - Clear, proactive communication with internal requesters and external partners - Comfort with budgets, forecasting and basic data analysis - A good eye for quality, plus the judgment to work within an established brand and creative direction YOU MIGHT EXCEL IF YOU… - Have founded, owned or run a merch, promotional products or production agency - Have launched or operated a branded merch store - Thrive in a fast-moving startup where you build the process as you go - Think like an owner of the merch program and its business impact, not just an executor of orders OUR COMMITMENT Equal Opportunity. cold_email.subject: Interest in Merch Manager — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear Cognition Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Merch Manager opportunity with Cognition at Cognition.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin

By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come. This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched. Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you. At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started. ROLE OVERVIEW The Scaled Customer Success Manager joins Harvey's Scaled Customer Success team to drive retention, renewal, and expansion outcomes across a high-volume book of business. The team's mission is to deliver strategic, efficient value at scale—ensuring customers adopt Harvey's AI solutions deeply and renew with confidence. This role owns the full commercial lifecycle for a portfolio of accounts, blending consultative customer engagement with a data-driven renewals motion to maximize net revenue retention. Scaled CSMs partners closely with Sales, Legal Engineering, and Product to translate customer feedback into roadmap influence and expansion opportunity. It is a rare opportunity to shape a growing function at the intersection of AI innovation and customer value delivery. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Own renewals and expansions across a named portfolio of accounts, driving net revenue retention and gross retention targets through proactive commercial engagement. - Lead scaled customer engagement motions—including QBRs, value reviews, and enablement sessions—to maximize product adoption and demonstrate ongoing ROI. - Monitor customer health using data and analytics, identifying churn signals early and executing structured intervention plans to protect and grow revenue. - Serve as a trusted advisor to customers with a prescriptive, consultative approach, integrating Harvey into their workflows and championing the power of LLMs. - Collaborate cross-functionally with Legal Engineering, Product, and Sales to relay customer insights, influence the product roadmap, and align on shared goals. - Build and refine scalable playbooks and processes that elevate the team's approach to customer engagement, renewals, and expansion. WHAT YOU HAVE - 3+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or a renewals-focused role within Enterprise SaaS, legal technology, or management consulting. - Demonstrated track record of managing a high-volume book of business and consistently meeting or exceeding retention and expansion targets. - Strong commercial acumen with experience owning renewals conversations and identifying upsell or expansion opportunities within existing accounts. - Excellent communication and strategic planning skills, with the ability to engage stakeholders at multiple levels and deliver polished QBRs and value reviews. - Data-driven mindset with experience leveraging customer health metrics, adoption data, and CS platforms to inform strategy. - Collaborative, proactive disposition with a team-first mentality and comfort operating in a fast-paced, ambiguity-rich environment. jobs.title: Lead Technical GTM Recruiter
jobs.description: About Glean: Glean is the Work AI platform that helps everyone work smarter with AI. What began as the industry’s most advanced enterprise search has evolved into a full-scale Work AI ecosystem, powering intelligent Search, an AI Assistant, and scalable AI agents on one secure, open platform. With over 100 enterprise SaaS connectors, flexible LLM choice, and robust APIs, Glean gives organizations the infrastructure to govern, scale, and customize AI across their entire business - without vendor lock-in or costly implementation cycles. At its core, Glean is redefining how enterprises find, use, and act on knowledge. Its Enterprise Graph and Personal Knowledge Graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context-aware responses for every employee. This foundation powers Glean’s agentic capabilities - AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry’s broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real-time. The result: measurable business impact through faster onboarding, hours of productivity gained each week, and smarter, safer decisions at every level. Recognized by Fast Company as one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies (Top 10, 2025), by CNBC’s Disruptor 50, Bloomberg’s AI Startups to Watch (2026), Forbes AI 50, and Gartner’s Tech Innovators in Agentic AI, Glean continues to accelerate its global impact. With customers across 50+ industries and 1,000+ employees in more than 25 countries, we’re helping the world’s largest organizations make every employee AI-fluent, and turning the superintelligent enterprise from concept into reality. If you’re excited to shape how the world works, you’ll help build systems used daily across Microsoft Teams, Zoom, ServiceNow, Zendesk, GitHub, and many more. You'll be deeply embedded where people get things done. You'll ship agentic capabilities on an open, extensible stack, with the craft and care required for enterprise trust, as we bring Work AI to every employee, in every company. About the Role: Glean is seeking a Lead Technical GTM Recruiter to own recruiting for our technical go-to-market organization. You’ll set strategy and lead full-cycle hiring across Solutions Engineering, Solutions Architecture, Applied AI, AI Outcome Leads, Technical Support Engineering, and related technical customer-facing roles. As a senior talent partner, you’ll advise leaders on talent markets and workforce needs, lead complex and critical searches, and strengthen recruiting practices beyond your own requisitions. You will: Own full-cycle recruiting strategy and execution across technical GTM roles, from intake and market mapping through sourcing, assessment, offer, and close. cold_email.subject: Interest in Designer, OpenAI.com — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear OpenAI Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Designer, OpenAI.com opportunity with OpenAI at OpenAI.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin

jobs.title: Workplace Operations Manager
jobs.description: About Us At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company. At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in. Available Locations: Austin, TX Work onsite in the office 5 days a week (Monday–Friday) About the Role The Places Team at Cloudflare is seeking a skilled, operationally rigorous Workplace Operations Manager to lead daily onsite workplace operations for our Austin hub. In this role, you will serve as the hands-on operational site lead and brand ambassador, driving workplace standards, executing regional directives, and delivering a consistent, high-touch employee and guest experience. Reporting directly to the Regional Workplace Operations Manager – NAMER , you will be the operational anchor on the ground, translating regional strategy into efficient site execution. You will partner with regional leadership, cross-functional partners (IT, Physical Security, People Operations, Legal, and Executive Briefing Centers), and local service partners to maintain a highly functional workplace for our distributed team. Balancing local site ownership with regional alignment, you bring practical expertise in facilities coordination, vendor oversight, and day-to-day budget tracking, combined with a hospitality mindset that reflects Cloudflare’s values and culture. Responsibilities Lead Onsite Hub Operations & Space Readiness: Oversee day-to-day workplace operations across the Austin hub—directing front-of-house services, shipping and receiving, routine building maintenance, and space readiness to ensure a welcoming, functional, and organized environment. Vendor Coordination & Service Quality: Oversee local vendor performance and daily service delivery across janitorial, culinary/catering, and maintenance partners. Monitor vendor compliance against regional SLAs, run local service reviews, and provide operational feedback to NAMER leadership for contract renewals and scope updates. Site Budget Tracking & Expense Management: Monitor and track the local operating expense (OpEx) budget in partnership with the Regional Manager. Review and reconcile local invoices, track monthly workplace spend, forecast site needs, and flag operational cost efficiencies. Local Workplace Experience & Engagement: Champion workplace culture onsite by implementing regional programs and organizing high-touch local initiatives that support hybrid collaboration, community engagement, and day-to-day employee satisfaction. Site Communications & Escalation: Serve as the primary local operational contact for Austin site leadership, cross-functional teams, and employees regarding facility updates, workplace protocols, and building announcements. Escalate site-level risks or operational roadblocks to NAMER leadership in a timely manner. Workplace Metrics & Space Insights: Track, analyze, and report site-level operational data—including daily occupancy, badge swipes, space utilization trends, and ticket resolution times—to inform regional space planning and workplace decisions. Amenities: Manage day-to-day workplace food and beverage operations, including lunch catering, micro-kitchen restocks, health and wellness amenities. Internal Events & Onsite Logistics: Manage logistical planning and day-of execution for onsite gatherings, executive visits, team offsites, and cultural celebrations, partnering closely with the Global Events & Experiences team and local organizers. Safety, Compliance & Preparedness: Serve as the onsite coordinator for facility safety and compliance. In partnership with Global Physical Security and building property management, facilitate local emergency response procedures, coordinate site safety team volunteers, lead routine drills, and maintain emergency readiness. Team Leadership & Site Support: Supervise, coach, and mentor local workplace operations team members and contractors. Serve as the local operational partner for regional real estate and design teams for various hub related reconfigurations, refreshes, or buildout projects. NAMER Regional Collaboration: Participate actively in regional operations syncs, sharing local operational insights, supporting peer site coverage across NAMER, and ensuring consistent policy rollouts across the region. Requirements 5–6+ years of progressive workplace or facilities operations experience , preferably within a high-growth tech company or dynamic corporate setting. 3+ years of direct people management experience , with demonstrated success in coaching, supervising, and developing onsite workplace team members. Hands-on vendor management experience , including monitoring day-to-day service deliverables, tracking SLA compliance, and collaborating with external facility providers. Operational financial discipline , with practical experience tracking local budgets, reviewing vendor invoices, and monitoring site operational expenses (OpEx). Familiarity with workplace tools & data , including integrated workplace management systems (IWMS), ticketing systems (e.g., Jira, Zendesk), visitor management platforms, and Google Workspace. Strong cross-functional collaboration skills , with a track record of partnering effectively with local and remote teams including, but not limited to: IT, People Ops, Real Estate, and Physical Security. Working knowledge of facility safety standards , including OSHA/EHS basics, local emergency response protocols, and building code considerations. Clear verbal and written communication skills , with the confidence to communicate operational updates to local leaders and collaborate smoothly with regional managers. Hospitality mindset & practical problem-solving , balancing high operational standards with a genuine dedication to delivering a supportive, employee-centric workplace. Onsite presence: Required to be onsite full-time, 5 days per week at our Austin hub. What Makes Cloudflare Special? We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet. Project Galileo : Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost. Athenian Project : In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states. 1.1.1.1 : We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers. Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you! Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs. More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process. This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license. jobs.title: Lead Solutions Engineer | Upmarket, ANZ
jobs.description: Who are we? At HubSpot, we empower thousands of businesses around the world to grow better. If you thrive in solving complex challenges, love learning, and enjoy collaborating with a global team, this role could be your next great opportunity. Our Australian office is based in Sydney, but we’re equally happy for you to join our team as a remote employee. For more information, check out: Hybrid at HubSpot AI is changing how businesses buy. Buyers arrive informed, and they want to see their own business running in HubSpot, with proof it will deliver results, before they commit. HubSpot's customer platform connects customer context, Breeze AI agents and a unified CRM, so growing businesses get real outcomes, not just new software. What’s the role As a Lead Solutions Engineer working with our Upmarket sales org (Midmarket/Corp), you'll partner with Account Executives to show mid-sized businesses what HubSpot can do for them, then prove it. You'll lead discovery, tell outcome-led stories through tailored demos, and build lightweight working proofs so customers can try their solution before they buy. This is a pre-sales role, not a software engineering role. It suits people who enjoy business conversations as much as building with technology, and who want to grow their technical, customer, communication and sales skills fast. If you love storytelling and building, you thrive at the intersection of business and technology, and want to help write the playbook for how software is bought next, this role is for you. What you'll do Work a varied pipeline of new and existing-customer deals alongside Account Executives, from discovery to the technical win. Lead discovery to understand each customer's goals, pain points, current systems and requirements. Tell compelling, outcome-led stories (via demos and product led experiences) that show customers how their business can be reimagined in HubSpot Partner with Account Executives to map the technical buying committee, competitive landscape and path to a decision. Design HubSpot solutions that fit the customer's processes and connect sensibly with the tools they already use. Build lightweight proofs of concept with AI tools, Breeze AI agents and HubSpot configuration, scoped to clear use cases and success criteria, and help customers try them hands-on. Answer ad-hoc or RFP-based technical, security and integration questions, collaborating with specialists and partners as needed. Help your AE shape the business case and value story for the customer's first use cases. Prove the outcome via use-case roadmap and a consumption plan that sizes the first commitment. Keep what you show realistic to deploy, and hand over clear context to solution architects, onboarding teams and partners so customers start strong and realise value fast. Lead by example: mentor other SEs, run initiatives, share field feedback and reusable assets with the team to improve our playbooks and product. Travel occasionally to customer sites. What you’ll bring: Experience in a customer-facing technical or consultative role for a SaaS product, such as solutions engineering, technical consulting, implementation, onboarding or customer success with a track record of winning complex deals or delivering solutions that moved business results. Humility and a growth mindset: the world of SaaS is changing fast and there is a lot of ambiguity. Nobody can know everything. You’re happy to lead from the front where needed and offer your support to team mates while equally being open to learn from others. Art-of-the-Possible Storytelling: Ability to turn a customer's goals into a compelling, outcome-led vision of their business reimagined in HubSpot. Outstanding communication skills & stakeholder management - both internal and external: you feel equally comfortable talking to IT as to C-suite, you can tell a story about business outcomes that resonates with stakeholders at various levels and you can successfully navigate multiple internal & external stakeholders. Curiosity in discovery: you ask good questions, dig deep into business, financial and individual pain, and pick up on needs customers don't explicitly share. Working knowledge of how SaaS platforms connect, including APIs, integrations and data migration and management. Hands-on experience building with AI tools, either professionally or in a personal project, and a demonstrable habit of learning as tools evolve. Manage a complex, multi-stakeholder pipeline independently, surfacing technical, commercial and timing risks before they land Nice to have Hands-on experience with HubSpot or a similar CRM platform. Projects you've built, deployed or hosted yourself, for example a portfolio you can walk us through. Experience with business cases, ROI conversations or consumption-based pricing (seats and credits). Experience supporting customers in their own environments after the sale. We have several roles open at different levels within this team within our Mid-Market and Corp segments. During the process, if we believe your experience may align more closely with another level/segment, we’ll discuss this with you and outline potential next steps. HubSpot offers a flexible, supportive environment designed to help you do your best work and grow your career: Competitive base salary, commissions and stock options Remote-first flexibility - work from home, the office, or hybrid Structured onboarding and ongoing learning opportunities (including an annual education allowance) Flexible Time Off policy Healthcare and wellness reimbursements Primary and Secondary Caregiver Leave Employee Resource Groups and inclusion programs to support belonging Volunteering time so you can give back to your community Consistently recognised as a great place to work by Comparably. Check out HubSpot’s careers site to see all our benefits and learn more about our culture. HubSpot’s culture is driven by a shared passion for our mission and metrics. It’s a culture of amazing, growth-minded people who solve for the customer, embrace boldness and adaptability, and thrive on alignment and collaboration. We know the confidence gap and impostor syndrome can get in the way of meeting spectacular candidates, so please don’t hesitate to apply - we’d love to hear from you. At HubSpot, we value both flexibility and connection. Whether you’re a Remote employee or work from the Office, we want you to start your journey here by building strong connections with your team and peers. If you are joining our Engineering team, you will be required to attend a regional HubSpot office for in-person onboarding. If you join our broader Product team, you’ll also attend other in-person events, such as your Product Group Summit and other gatherings, to continue building on those connections. jobs.description: POS-34062 Partner Specialist, DACH In this role, you will be responsible for identifying, sourcing, and closing good fit partners for HubSpot as part of the HubSpot Solutions Partner Program. Using strong consultative selling skills and a wealth of knowledge in managing partners, you will exercise a hunter mindset by sourcing for your own pipeline in collaboration with Sales, Partnerships as well as managing inbound enquiries. In this role you are responsible for selling the value of HubSpot’s Agentic Customer Platform, and the Partner Program. During the sales process, you will guide prospective partners as they learn how HubSpot can help them improve their client acquisition rates, client retention rates and overall business profitability. You will own the full region on your own, covering partners of all sizes, from small to large. In this role you will: Create a quality pipeline of potential partner acquisitions using HubSpot’s own CRM & AI prospecting tools to identify, recruit, and develop prospective high value partners for the HubSpot Solution Partner Program. Dissect a partner’s business goals, identify any business pain associated with not joining the program and help them develop a better plan for achieving growth (with the use of Crossbeam) Become an expert at presenting how the loop marketing methodology and HubSpot’s software (with a focus on AI) can help a partner improve the fundamentals of their business Collaborate closely with internal stakeholders to support on the acquisition process including the Head of Acquisition & Growth, Regional sales leads and the EMEA partner leaders Bring your thinking, strategies, and ideas to advance our company’s values, unique culture, and vision for the future We are looking for people who: Have experience in partner sales or as an Account Executive, with at least 2 to 3 years of experience in Sales, and know what makes partners of all sizes successful Work with tenacity and have the desire and commitment to do what it takes to be successful in partnerships Have a positive outlook and a strong ability to take responsibility for their successes and failures showing business acumen and adaptability Have exceptional consultative selling skills and closing skills with partners Have a sharp focus on their goals and a belief that their daily, weekly and monthly activities will help achieve them Are fluent in English and German and are based in Germany or Ireland Have worked in a fast-paced SMB or scale-up environment, similar to HubSpot’s own customer base At HubSpot, we value both flexibility and connection. Whether you’re a Remote employee or work from the Office, we want you to start your journey here by building strong connections with your team and peers. If you are joining our Engineering team, you will be required to attend a regional HubSpot office for in-person onboarding.
